nodes.Name: FS
nodes.DocComment:
An FS is a read-only collection of files, usually initialized with a //go:embed directive.
When declared without a //go:embed directive, an FS is an empty file system.

An FS is a read-only value, so it is safe to use from multiple goroutines
simultaneously and also safe to assign values of type FS to each other.

FS implements fs.FS, so it can be used with any package that understands
file system interfaces, including net/http, text/template, and html/template.

See the package documentation for more details about initializing an FS.

nodes.Name: split
nodes.DocComment:
split splits the name into dir and elem as described in the
comment in the FS struct above. isDir reports whether the
final trailing slash was present, indicating that name is a directory.

nodes.Name: file
nodes.DocComment:
A file is a single file in the FS.
It implements fs.FileInfo and fs.DirEntry.

nodes.Name: dotFile
nodes.DocComment:
dotFile is a file for the root directory,
which is omitted from the files list in a FS.

nodes.Name: lookup
nodes.DocComment: lookup returns the named file, or nil if it is not present.

nodes.Name: readDir
nodes.DocComment: readDir returns the list of files corresponding to the directory dir.

nodes.Name: Open
nodes.DocComment:
Open opens the named file for reading and returns it as an [fs.File].

The returned file implements [io.Seeker] and [io.ReaderAt] when the file is not a directory.

nodes.Name: ReadDir
nodes.DocComment: ReadDir reads and returns the entire named directory.

nodes.Name: ReadFile
nodes.DocComment: ReadFile reads and returns the content of the named file.

nodes.Name: openFile
nodes.DocComment: An openFile is a regular file open for reading.

nodes.Name: openDir
nodes.DocComment: An openDir is a directory open for reading.

Fields.Name: offset
Fields.DocComment: the read offset, an index into the files slice

nodes.Name: sortSearch
nodes.DocComment: sortSearch is like sort.Search, avoiding an import.
